title: How the exit engine measures price

options.name: Keep current behaviour: quote a fixed probe (the ETH buy amount reused as a raw token amount) and compare outputs
options.risk: The signal is not a price: thresholds mean different moves per token, a 0 or Infinity baseline sells at the wrong time, a null quote skips even the urgency exit, and a changed probe after restart or re-arm fires false exits (AUD-EXIT-003, AUD-EXIT-015).

options.name: Read decimals once and quote a small fixed fraction of the held position; persist the probe with the entry
options.behavior_impact: Thresholds track the real sell value of the position; restart compares like with like.
options.risk: Still a quote-based signal (one RPC call per tick), sensitive to quoter reverts.

options.name: Compute spot price from pool reserves (V2) or slot0 (V3) and compare prices
options.behavior_impact: Exit thresholds become true price moves.
options.risk: Spot price ignores price impact of selling the whole position; needs per-dex reserve/slot0 reads.

recommendation: decimals-aware-probe sized to the held position (it measures what the exit would actually receive), with a 0/non-finite baseline rejected and the urgency exit firing even on a null quote; measure on a Phase 23 fork with low-decimal and high-supply tokens before deciding.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides what number the stop-loss, trailing stop and partial tiers compare against.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
